stages.log: Con-Reg holds the paper on eleven years of your boots. Lose the paper, and the Company has to find you the hard way. Rook's job, on the board: lose your file from Depot 4's terminal.

objectives.text: Win Losing the paper on the board

stages.why: The ship launched: the job went to someone else.

stages.log: Your file is gone from Depot 4. Con-Reg will find the paper again, but not this month. Con-Reg's courier, with your paper filed again: marked on the chart.
stages.why: The run left the charts behind.

stages.log: Con-Reg's claims tender, within reach of the colony: Recovery holds her.
